_note: The header menu (owner, 28 Oct 2026; Stage 2 screen design specification section 6, navigation map). Read by lld-tools/menu.php. `wp lld menu apply` rebuilds the menu named here in place, because the Newspaper header template pins its menu by ID. The Articles dropdown lists the top-level categories of data/categories.json in order, so it always follows FR2-26. Items with the class lld-menu-members link to membership pages and stay hidden while the lld-members plugin is inactive (the live site until the Stage 2 launch). lld-menu-signed-out and lld-menu-signed-in follow sign-in; lld-menu-cta is styled as a button. A page that is missing or unpublished is skipped with a warning.
